char *golLogicCode = \
        "#version 430\n" \
        "layout (local_size_x = 16, local_size_y = 16) in;\n" \
        "layout (r32ui, binding = 0) uniform uimage2D img_output;\n" \
        "\n" \
        "struct GolUpdateCmd {\n" \
        "    uint x;\n" \
        "    uint y;\n" \
        "    uint w;\n" \
        "    uint enabled;\n" \
        "};\n" \
        "\n" \
        "struct GolUpdateSSBO {\n" \
        "    uint count;\n" \
        "    GolUpdateCmd commands[48];\n" \
        "};\n" \
        "\n" \
        "layout (std430, binding = 1) buffer ssbo\n" \
        "{\n" \
        "    GolUpdateSSBO buf;\n" \
        "};\n" \
        "\n" \
        "bool is_alive(ivec2 coords) {\n" \
        "    return imageLoad(img_output, coords).r > 0;\n" \
        "}\n" \
        "\n" \
        "void main() {\n" \
        "    ivec2 coords = ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy);\n" \
        "    \n" \
        "    // Process mouse commands\n" \
        "    for (int i = 0; i < buf.count; i++) {\n" \
        "        if (coords.x >= buf.commands[i].x && coords.x < (buf.commands[i].x + buf.commands[i].w) &&\n" \
        "            coords.y >= buf.commands[i].y && coords.y < (buf.commands[i].y + buf.commands[i].w)) {\n" \
        "            imageStore(img_output, coords, uvec4(buf.commands[i].enabled, 0, 0, 0));\n" \
        "            return;\n" \
        "        }\n" \
        "    }\n" \
        "\n" \
        "    int neighbors = 0;\n" \
        "    for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {\n" \
        "        for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {\n" \
        "            if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;\n" \
        "            if (is_alive(coords + ivec2(i, j))) neighbors++;\n" \
        "        }\n" \
        "    }\n" \
        "\n" \
        "    if (is_alive(coords)) {\n" \
        "        if (neighbors < 2 || neighbors > 3) imageStore(img_output, coords, uvec4(0, 0, 0, 0));\n" \
        "    } else {\n" \
        "        if (neighbors == 3) imageStore(img_output, coords, uvec4(1, 0, 0, 0));\n" \
        "    }\n" \
        "}";
